sources.title: Cupid Limited FY27 shareholder notices and September 30 Q2 business update
Cupid consolidated valuation, financial and shareholding snapshot
Economic Times on Cupid's second FY27 guidance increase
Business Today on Cupid FY27 guidance and Q2 momentum

claims.statement: Fresh review of company financials and the current consolidated snapshot confirms strong FY26 and June-2026-quarter growth, with the June quarter showing materially higher sales and profit than the year-earlier period.

Latest available quarterly ownership shows FII holding rising to 4.17% in June 2026 from 1.01% in March 2026 and DII holding rising to 0.34% from 0.17%, while promoter ownership also edged higher; this is positive historical ownership evidence, not current-session flow.

Cupid's September 30 Q2 FY27 business update and two independent reports confirm a second upward revision of FY27 guidance to about Rs 800 crore revenue and Rs 250 crore net profit, with Q2 revenue expected above Rs 200 crore; actual audited Q2 results remain pending.

The freshly retrieved snapshot displayed a very elevated valuation at roughly 301x earnings and about 91x book value; this is a material negative valuation input but not a standalone short recommendation.

Fresh review of company notices, financial reports and independent coverage identified no verified company-specific severe shock such as default, fraud, insolvency, ban or auditor resignation. Recent SAST, trading-window and warrant notices are not relabelled as severe Event-Shock evidence.

limitations: Management guidance is not audited Q2 financial results.
The stock's large historical price appreciation and high valuation increase downside sensitivity but do not by themselves determine direction.
Quarterly ownership is historical evidence and does not prove same-session institutional flow.
Live price, volume and technical evidence must be acquired independently by the governed market-data engine.
